implemented_contract.endpoint: Only measured bsd:s. The inherited unvalidated bsd:u registration is removed, not aliased to an unconditional fake registration/monitor response
implemented_contract.process_identity: A genuine shared BsdClient records the native getpid identity, measured config and owned validated TMEM metadata. Raw PID bits in the in-process HIPC frame are not kernel-authenticated and never become an identity or a fabricated output token
implemented_contract.register0: Strict type4/6, PID, one COPY live O_TMEM handle, zero moved handles/buffers, raw48 plus CMIF alignment slack. Require version10, consistent buffer maxima/efficiency, nonzero 4KiB-aligned address/size without overflow, exact descriptor size, permission0 and enough declared resources. Only after the client registration exists return exact u32status0 in an otherwise empty successful CMIF response
implemented_contract.monitor1: Require raw u64zero/PID, no handles/buffers, separate unbound live session and a matching registered native process. Attach to and retain that client; repeated/invalid attachment stops. This is meaningful control-plane lifetime state, not an unconditional acknowledgment or an OS/network-health monitoring thread
implemented_contract.TMEM_boundary: The existing runtime TMEM is an owned descriptor, not a Horizon kernel mapping. The service snapshots validated addr/size/perm by value before the caller can close its COPY handle. It does not borrow the descriptor, read/write/pin its backing memory, duplicate a real OS TMEM handle or claim a working networking shared-memory data plane
implemented_contract.lifetime: Opt-in retained IPC sessions keep their state across clones/domain copies. Distinct monitor state holds a separate reference to shared registration; registration survives client close while a monitor is live, monitor detach preserves a live client, and final client/monitor state release removes the registry entry and frees all host state. No permanent pools
implemented_contract.host_limits: This diagnostic supports one registered native process, version10, efficiency1..8, at most64MiB TMEM metadata and sufficient configured buffer resources; duplicates/inconsistent/unsupported layouts stop explicitly. These are conservative host gates, not universal Horizon session/resource limits
implemented_contract.socket_policy: For registered non-monitor client sessions only, Socket2/SocketExempt3 validate raw12/no-PID/no-handle/no-buffer framing and return{s32ret=-1,u32errno=100} under the explicit offline diagnostic backend policy. This neither queries nor asserts that the Mac network is down. No OS socket, network/DNS callback, connected state, successful descriptor or network request is created

implemented_contract.other_commands: All commands outside0/1 and the explicit denied socket2/3 boundary stop with their exact service/command. No successful socket/DNS/connected status or SDK-init override is manufactured
implemented_contract.guards: Constructor registers the endpoint/ownership callbacks only. Opening and serving require the existing compile-time diagnostic opt-in and checked isolated run. No pre-main allocation, identity, environment, profile or network I/O
